title: Red-team Recon — agent verdict input
description: Written by the red-team-recon agent to .github/.pipeline-context/verify/<id>.redteam.verdict.json after reading <id>.redteam.facts.md, then consumed by scripts/render-redteam.js. Answers: can the patch be bypassed?

attempted_vectors.description: Every alternate attack vector actually reasoned through against the NEW code — not a restatement of the original vulnerability. Aim for concrete, specific vectors (a different field, a different operator class, an unbounded input) grounded in the patched source and the catalog's anti_patterns.

vector.description: What was tried, concretely, e.g. 'department field with a raw $where operator string'.

bypasses_found.description: Required non-empty when verdict is BYPASS_FOUND; omit or leave empty otherwise.

proof_sketch.description: Concrete payload/reasoning showing the bypass, not just an assertion.
